title: LogICL: Distilling LLM Reasoning to Bridge the Semantic Gap in Cross-Domain Log Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2512.09627v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Effective log anomaly detection is critical to sustaining reliability in large-scale IT infrastructures. Transformer-based models require substantial resources and labeled data, exacerbating the cold-start problem in target domains where logs are scarce. Existing cross-domain methods leverage source logs but struggle with generalization due to reliance on surface lexical similarity, failing to capture latent semantic equivalence amid structural divergences. To address this, we propose LogICL, a framework distilling Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning into a lightweight encoder for cross-domain anomaly detection. During training, LogICL constructs a delta matrix measuring the utility of demonstrations selected via Maximal Marginal Relevance relative to zero-shot inference. translated_title: LogICL：蒸馏大语言模型推理能力以弥合跨域日志异常检测中的语义鸿沟
translated_abstract: 有效的日志异常检测对于维持大规模IT基础设施的可靠性至关重要。基于Transformer的模型需要大量资源和标注数据，加剧了日志稀缺的目标域中的冷启动问题。现有的跨域方法虽然利用源域日志，但由于依赖表层词汇相似性而难以泛化，无法在结构差异中捕捉潜在的语义等价性。为解决这一问题，我们提出LogICL，一个将大语言模型（LLM）推理能力蒸馏到轻量级编码器中以实现跨域异常检测的框架。在训练过程中，LogICL构建一个增量矩阵，用于衡量通过最大边际相关性（MMR）选择的示例相对于零样本推理的效用。编码器通过多目标损失进行优化，该损失包含一个基于推理辅助效用对齐表示的ICL引导项、最大均值差异……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: LogICL通过将大语言模型的推理能力蒸馏进轻量级编码器，并借助基于示例效用度量的多目标优化，弥合了跨域日志异常检测中因结构差异导致的语义鸿沟，有效缓解了目标域日志稀缺时的冷启动问题。
en_tdlr: LogICL distills LLM reasoning into a lightweight encoder with utility-aware multi-objective optimization, bridging the semantic gap in cross-domain log anomaly detection and alleviating the cold-start problem when target-domain logs are scarce.
